entries.german: Hans von Rosenberg hat etliche gerechtigkait, aigenleut vnd anders zu lauda, Maibach, Konigshofen herbfelt vnd anders dem Stift verkauft Recepta in contractum originale sub litera R Kommentar: Die Datumsangabe orientiert sich an der Lebenszeit von Johann von Rosenberg.
entries.english: Hans von Rosenberg sold the bishopric several rights, serfs, and other things at Lauda, Maibach, Königshofen, Herbfeld, and elsewhere. Recorded in the register of contracts; original filed under letter R. Editorial note: The date is based on the lifespan of Hans von Rosenberg.

facts.content: sold rights, serfs, and other things at Lauda, Maibach, Königshofen, Herbfeld, and elsewhere to the bishopric.
